cluster_config:
# Whether admin API clients must provide HTTP Basic authentication headers (e.g. 'true')
admin_api_require_auth: false

# Enable aggregations of metrics returned by the prometheus '/metrics' endpoint. Metric aggregation is performed by summing the values of samples by labels. Aggregations are performed where it makes sense by the shard and/or partition labels. (e.g. 'true')
aggregate_metrics: false

# Maximum number of bytes the internal audit client will allocate for audit log records. Disable and re-enable auditing for changes to take affect
audit_client_max_buffer_size: 16777216

# Enable/Disable audit logging. (e.g. 'true')
audit_enabled: false

# List of event classes that will be audited, options are: [management, produce, consume, describe, heartbeat, authenticate, admin, schema_registry]. Please refer to the documentation to know exactly which request(s) map to a particular audit event type. (e.g. '["management", "describe"]')
audit_enabled_event_types:
    - management
    - authenticate
    - admin

# List of user principals to exclude from auditing (e.g. '["User:principal1","User:principal2"]')
audit_excluded_principals: []
# List of topics to exclude from auditing (e.g. '["topic1","topic2"]')
audit_excluded_topics: []
# Number of partitions for the internal audit log topic. Attempt to create topic is only performed if it doesn't already exist, disable and re-enable auditing for changes to take affect
audit_log_num_partitions: 12

# Replication factor of the internal audit log topic. Attempt to create topic is only performed if it doesn't already exist, disable and re-enable auditing for changes to take affect.  If unset, defaults to `default_topic_replication` (may be nil)
audit_log_replication_factor:

# Allow topic auto creation (e.g. 'true')
auto_create_topics_enabled: true

# AWS access key (restart required, may be nil)
cloud_storage_access_key:

# Optional API endpoint (restart required, may be nil)
cloud_storage_api_endpoint:

# TLS port override (restart required)
cloud_storage_api_endpoint_port: 443

# Azure Data Lake Storage v2 endpoint override. Use when Hierarchical Namespaces are enabled on your storage account and you have set up a custom endpoint. (restart required, may be nil)
cloud_storage_azure_adls_endpoint:

# Azure Data Lake Storage v2 port override. Also see cloud_storage_azure_adls_endpoint. (restart required, may be nil)
cloud_storage_azure_adls_port:

# The name of the Azure container to use with Tiered Storage. Note that the container must belong to 'cloud_storage_azure_storage_account' (restart required, may be nil)
cloud_storage_azure_container:

# The managed identity ID to use with Azure Managed Identities. This takes affect when the cloud_storage_credential_source configuration option is set to azure_vm_instance_metadata. (may be nil)
cloud_storage_azure_managed_identity_id:

# The shared key to be used for Azure Shared Key authentication with the configured Azure storage account (see 'cloud_storage_azure_storage_account)'. Note that Redpanda expects this string to be Base64 encoded. (may be nil)
cloud_storage_azure_shared_key:

# The name of the Azure storage account to use with Tiered Storage (restart required, may be nil)
cloud_storage_azure_storage_account:

# Optional cloud storage backend variant used to select API capabilities. If not supplied, will be inferred from other configuration parameters. (one of aws, google_s3_compat, azure, minio, oracle_s3_compat, unknown, restart required)
cloud_storage_backend: unknown

# AWS bucket that should be used to store data (restart required, may be nil)
cloud_storage_bucket:

# Max size of archival cache
cloud_storage_cache_size: 0

# The maximum size of the archival cache as a percentage of unreserved disk space (see disk_reservation_percent). The default value for this option is tuned for a shared disk configuration. When using a dedicated cache disk consider increasing the value. (e.g. '20.0', may be nil)
cloud_storage_cache_size_percent: 20

# The source of credentials to connect to cloud services (one of config_file, aws_instance_metadata, sts, gcp_instance_metadata, azure_aks_oidc_federation, azure_vm_instance_metadata, restart required)
cloud_storage_credentials_source: config_file

# Path to certificate revocation list for cloud_storage_trust_file. (restart required, may be nil)
cloud_storage_crl_file:

# Use legacy upload mode and do not start archiver_manager. (e.g. 'false', restart required)
cloud_storage_disable_archiver_manager: true

# Disable TLS for all S3 connections (e.g. 'true', restart required)
cloud_storage_disable_tls: false

# Enable archival storage (e.g. 'true', restart required)
cloud_storage_enabled: false

# Max number of simultaneous connections to S3 per shard (includes connections used for both uploads and downloads) (restart required)

# AWS region that houses the bucket used for storage (restart required, may be nil)

# AWS secret key (restart required, may be nil)
cloud_storage_secret_key:

# Path to certificate that should be used to validate server certificate during TLS handshake (restart required, may be nil)
cloud_storage_trust_file:

# Specifies the addressing style to use for Amazon S3 requests. This configuration determines how S3 bucket URLs are formatted. You can choose between: `virtual_host`, (e.g. `<bucket-name>.s3.amazonaws.com`), `path`, (e.g. `s3.amazonaws.com/<bucket-name>`), and `null`. Path style is supported for backward compatibility with legacy systems. When this property is not set (`null`), the client tries to use `virtual_host` addressing. If the initial request fails, the client automatically tries the `path` style. If neither addressing style works, Redpanda terminates the startup, requiring manual configuration to proceed. (one of {virtual_host}, {path}, {nullopt}, restart required, may be nil)
cloud_storage_url_style:

core_balancing_continuous: false

# If set to 'true', and if after a restart the number of cores changes, Redpanda will move partitions between cores to maintain balanced partition distribution. (e.g. 'false')
core_balancing_on_core_count_change: true

# The sample period for the CPU profiler (e.g. '100')

The maximum number of functions that can be deployed to a cluster is equal to data_transforms_per_core_memory_reservation / data_transforms_per_function_memory_limit (e.g. '26214400', restart required)
data_transforms_per_core_memory_reservation: 20971520

# The amount of memory to give an instance of a Data Transform WebAssembly Virtual Machine. The maximum number of functions that can be deployed to a cluster is equal to data_transforms_per_core_memory_reservation / data_transforms_per_function_memory_limit (e.g. '5242880', restart required)

disable_public_metrics: false

enable_controller_log_rate_limiting: false

# Enable idempotent producer (e.g. 'false', restart required)
enable_idempotence: true

enable_schema_id_validation: none
